'''Alina Carmen Cojocaru''' ({{IPA|ro|aˈlina ˈkarmen koʒoˈkaru}}) is a Romanian [[mathematician]] who works in [[number theory]] and is known for her research on [[elliptic curve]]s, [[arithmetic geometry]], and [[sieve theory]]. She is a professor of mathematics at the [[University of Illinois at Chicago]] and a researcher in the [[Institute of Mathematics of the Romanian Academy]].{{r|uic}}

Cojocaru earned her Ph.D. from [[Queen's University at Kingston|Queen's University]] in [[Kingston, Ontario]], in 2002. Her dissertation, ''Cyclicity of Elliptic Curves Modulo p'', was jointly supervised by [[M. Ram Murty]] and Ernst Kani.{{r|mgp}}

Cojocaru was elected to be an [[American Mathematical Society]] (AMS) Council member at large from February 1, 2023, to January 31, 2024.{{r|council}}

==Books==
Cojocaru is an author of the book
*''An Introduction to Sieve Methods and their Applications'' (with M. Ram Murty, London Mathematical Society Student Texts 66, Cambridge University Press, 2006).{{r|sieve}}
She is also an editor of
*''Women in Numbers: Research Directions in Number Theory'' (with [[Kristin Lauter]], [[Rachel Justine Pries]], and [[Renate Scheidler]], Fields Institute Communications 60, American Mathematical Society, 2011).
*''Scholar: A Scientific Celebration Highlighting Open Lines of Arithmetic Research: Conference in Honour of M. Ram Murty's Mathematical Legacy on His 60th Birthday'' (with C. David and F. Pappalardi, Contemporary Mathematics 655, American Mathematical Society, 2016)

== Selected publications ==

* Cojocaru, Alina Carmen; Murty, M. Ram (2004), "Cyclicity of elliptic curves modulo and elliptic curve analogues of Linnik's problem". ''[[Mathematische Annalen|Math. Ann.]]'' 330, no. 3, 601–625. [https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=2099195 MR 2099195].
* Cojocaru, Alina Carmen (2005), "On the surjectivity of the Galois representations associated to non-CM elliptic curves. With an appendix by Ernst Kani". ''[[Canad. Math. Bull.]]'' 48, no. 1, 16–31. [https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=2118760 MR 2118760.]
* Cojocaru, Alina Carmen; Hall, Chris (2005). "Uniform results for Serre's theorem for elliptic curves". ''[[International Mathematics Research Notices|Int. Math. Res. Not.]]'', no. 50, 3065–3080. [https://mathscinet.ams.org/mathscinet-getitem?mr=2189500 MR 2189500].
